::: {.why}
You know the bootstrap better than most people in this field; what is new is that the iid version destroys exactly the structure that week 6 spent five days measuring.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Say what an iid bootstrap does to volatility clustering, and which statistics it therefore gives wrong intervals for.
- Show the interval width difference between iid and block resampling for a statistic that depends on dependence.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>55 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}

:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [30 min]{.task-min} Show where it matters: build bootstrap intervals for three statistics, the mean, the Sharpe ratio, and the maximum drawdown, under both schemes.
